A few clarifying points from Priya and Procurement included:

- How will billing for long-running KV-cache warmups be treated in a POC?
- We need a short feature matrix: Redwood vs OrionAI vs CloudServe focused on private deployment, SOC2 evidence, and model quantization support.

We can be flexible on scheduling the POC kickoff next week — preferred time windows are Tue/Wed mornings PT. Procurement (procurement@datapulse.io) asked for an initial cost estimate for a 2-week POC.

Alex — great to see alignment on the main priorities. I captured the asks and sketched a proposed plan below so everyone has clear next steps. High-level summary from our side: DataPulse is evaluating for latency-sensitive customer support summarization and an internal analytics pipeline (heavy embedding use). Main pain: unpredictable tail latency at scale and high unit costs for long-context summarization. Goals you called out: predictable 99th percentile latency, sub-$0.02/1000-token cost target for embeddings pipeline, and SOC2 evidence for Private deployment.

Recommended POC plan (48–72 hours active testing + 7 days observation):
1) Baseline run (day 0–1): load OrionAI (your current vendor) at sampled traffic to collect baseline 99p and throughput.
2) Redwood parity runs (day 2–3): 48-hour sustained test at 50 QPS with our KV caching enabled; measure 50rps/100qps/50qps bursts to evaluate autoscale behavior.
3) Feature parity probes (parallel): streaming long-form summarization, embedders throughput, and memory usage with quantized variants.
4) Security/compliance dropbox: we’ll upload SOC2 artifacts and a short attestation for the Private deployment.

Immediate asks from us to you:
- Confirm preferred POC kickoff window (Tue/Wed morning PT)
- Share a redacted sample of 1–2 long form summarization prompts + expected length distribution (so we can tune batch/kv settings)
- Procurement: rough target budget for a 2-week trial so we can draft a proposal

I’ll loop in Solutions (Camila) and Competitive (Marissa) for the runbook and the feature matrix. We’ll deliver a compact matrix that highlights decision criteria (latency, throughput, cost, private deployment maturity, security evidence).

Owners:
- Camila Reyes: POC runbook & ops cadence (camila_reyes@redwood.com)
- Marissa Cole: competitor matrix & gap analysis (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Jasmine Liu: pricing & kickoff coordination (jasmine_liu@redwood.com)

I attached a starter feature matrix and the 48hr POA draft for review. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm Tue/Wed.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-10T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick demo — follow-ups

Alex — adding a bit more color on the operational probes we propose during the parity run. Quick bullets so you can forward to your infra folks: 

- Warmup & KV cache plan: start with a 4-hour warmup using historical prefixes, then maintain a rolling 6-hour window to preserve cache hit rate. We’ll report cache hit ratio and per-token compute reduction.
- Autoscale stalls: we’ll instrument scale-up latency and cold-starts for new pods; objective is < 3s per pod ramp when hitting burst capacity.
- Streaming validation: we’ll run a multi-turn summarization job that emits incremental chunks (checkpoint every 512 tokens) and verify end-to-end latency vs partial-chunk latency.
- Cost measuring: we’ll keep token accounting separated (generation vs KV vs embedding) so you can map to your internal chargeback model.

Open questions for DataPulse infra:
- Can you provide a VPN tunnel or temporary VPC peering for the Private stack trial, or do you prefer hosted (Redwood API) with logging capture?
- Any regulatory constraints for log retention beyond 90 days?

I’ll prepare the brief runbook with exact commands and a minimal observability dashboard (99p, p95, throughput, cache-hit) and share it to the Drive link Jasmine posted.

Thanks,
Camila
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya@datapulse.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick demo — follow-ups

Thanks — the plan looks reasonable. A couple of notes from procurement/security before we lock dates: 

- Procurement: target budget for a two-week POC is ~$8k–12k depending on deployment mode (hosted vs private). Please include a line item for data egress if we use hosted.
- Security: we prefer Private deployment but can accept hosted if you provide a temporary VPC peering with end-to-end encryption and access to audit logs. Also need a SOC2 snapshot and a short description of key management options (KMS/HSM).
- Decision criteria: we’ll weight latency (35%), cost (30%), deployment fit/security (20%), and product velocity/observability (15%).

Next steps:
1) Jasmine — please send a calendar invite for Tue Aug 17 9:30am PT for POC kickoff; include runbook link + pre-signed log delivery sample.
2) Camila — drop the runbook to the Drive and include the test harness commands.
3) Marissa — please circulate the competitor matrix with explicit gap bullets we can validate during the POC.

We’ll share a redacted sample prompt within 24 hours.

Best,
Priya Shah
CTO (acting), DataPulse
